quest.title: Aranaga's Memory
quest.description: You meet an old man named Khayyam in the forest. He seems to share a past with Aranara. It should do no harm to respond to his request for help...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.text: Haha, interesting... That's really curious. It's reviving, the forest is... reviving...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello, grandpa! Are you lost?
Hmm...hmm? Rost...? Ah, are you talking to me? Haha, lost, is that what you said? No, no, I'm not lost...

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Good day, kids. I am Giyath Khayyam, an Amu{RUBY#[S]Biology}rta Dastur, haha... Just call me Khayyam.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Hello, Mr. Khayyam!

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: No... Follow me, lower the tip of your tongue, and arch the middle of it... Khaaa. After that, round your mouth... Yyaaa. Finally, close your lips naturally... Mmm.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um... Khaaa... Yyaaa... Mmm...

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: That's right! Well done! Now, golden one, repeat that.

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Haha, nice! You did much better than the white little thing! See? I said I could teach phonetics!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, Mr. Khayyam... If you're not lost, what are you doing here?

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: What am I doing? Hehe... I am a forest researcher. For us, the forest is our hometown. How could I be lost in my hometown, where I finally returned?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh...

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: The forest was once deeply troubled by The Withering. In the past three decades, the plants were quickly decreasing in species and numbers, while the malicious Shroom-Kin kept growing...

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: However, The Withering nearby disappeared lately. The plants that were once gone started growing again, and the reproduction of Shroom-Kin was somehow restrained.

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: I haven't seen anything like this since 60 years ago... So I came here for the purpose of validating my amateur guess.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon sees...

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Haha, that happened 60 years ago... Lower your expectations, an old man like me might not remember it well. But I am convinced that the disappearance of The Withering is related to that specific matter...

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Therefore, I am entering this cave to collect some samples to prove my guess.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon gets it... But it's still dangerous there, even without any Marana in the cave.

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Haha, that is nothing for me...

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Hmm, wait... What did you just say? What was that in the cave?

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Hmm... On second thought, maybe I do need your help.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mmhmm, Paimon told you so!

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Hehe, please pardon me... But I haven't asked for your names.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #Just call me {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And Paimon's Paimon! Paiii...monnn...!

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Paimon? Paimon... Haha, that's an interesting name... You are the first human... Or fairy I know with the name.

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Oh, apologies, apologies. I did not mean to offend you... I meant this little thing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Little thing! That's pretty offensive already!

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Well, guess that's all for the chit-chat. Please follow me, Javans, it's time to get moving.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Javans"...? What does that mean?

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: An ancient word in the dialect of my hometown, which means "brave young ones."

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: More precisely, it means... "Young ones who never neglect gigantic evil, or ever back off from endless disparity."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, that's pretty much us!

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Oh? You see yourselves like that? Haha, follow me then.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ehh? Grandpa Khayyam, can you really keep up with us?

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Haha... I've been studying the forest for almost 30 years, so don't underestimate this old man's stamina! Just go on ahead, I'll catch up real soon.

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Haha... Many thanks to you, my helpful children. I am physically old, but still mentally capable. Don't underestimate me.

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: After all, I know how to please the forest, so that it won't hurt me.

choices.text: What are you doing here, Khayyam?

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Hmm... Your pronunciation was too fast, too rapid. But it's fine... Slowing it down would be all you need.

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: I am focusing my investigation mainly on three sites. Haha, I hope my memories of 30 years ago haven't totally faded... I should be able to identify the locations.

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: All in all, thanks for your companionship.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't mention it, Mr. Khayyam! That's what we Javans should do!

talks.objective: Investigate the plants in the specified locations

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Why come here, you two?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa!! Y—You scared Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Know my name, you two. But has never seen you here before, Aranaga.

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: So... why come here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even if you have forgotten many things, you should know that we don't mean any harm! We're always on your side, and we'll always help Mawtiyima!

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Mawtiyima... You know?

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Hmph, don't look like bad guys, you.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: But please don't stay, here. Leave soon. Still recovering, the forest... So, no staying here, new guests.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, wait!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We have something for you!

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Something, for me?

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Give me.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: See? Remember? You gave us the same flower before!

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Really... are friends with me? Very important flower, why here, with you?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You explain all the adventures in detail to Aranaga, as well as how you saved Mawtiyima from The Withering.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What about that? Rings a bell?

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Don't understand, don't remember...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whaaat!?

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: But, thank you. My garden, if remember. Please come.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Very important flower, will plant, Aranaga.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Aranaga leaves with the flower.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aranaga just... left.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, Aranaga invited us to his garden, though... That means he didn't refuse to be friends with us, right? Let's pay him a visit sometime!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... That's right. Let's visit Aranaga sometime, shall we?

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Friends...?

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Interesting... The plants here seem to be... reviving. So Mawtiyima is back in effect... Magical.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh... So Mr. Khayyam knows about Mawtiyima, too? Paimon thought only Aranara know that...

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Aranara, right? So you have also seen them...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh...? Um... Y—Yes.

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: "Iram indeed is gone with all its Rose, and Jamshyd's Sev'n-ring'd Cup where no one Knows."

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: We should proceed to the next site.

talks.objective: Investigate the plants in the specified locations

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: The plants here are growing pretty nicely...

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: I never thought soil that had been tainted by Marana could ever provide nourishment for plants again.

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Dismissing the unique lifeforms that kids call Aranara as "imaginary friends" is undoubtedly incorrect.

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Since the Akademiya sensors couldn't detect them either, only young kids could prove that they exist.

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Hence, Amu{RUBY#[S]Biology}rta has classified them as "unidentified lifeforms."

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Ha! Here! Look at this!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? New plant? Why are you so excited?

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: No, not that, but even better! Look at it, our secret castle! Ha! What a mess it is now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh...? "Secret castle"?

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Haha! Here returns Scholar Omar! He came with the celestial secrets! Irfan, Siman, where are you! Aren't you bidding a welcome to me?

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Ah... Ahem, my apologies, children. I... I was carried away.

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Old age always does this to me, blurring the present, and endearing the past, more and more... Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Irfan and Siman, they are friends of mine. We built the castle together, the three of us together.

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Back then, Irfan was the great musician, Siman was the supreme commander, and I was the astrology scholar. We switched our roles sometimes, you know... Children would play something different after getting bored.

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Irfan was talented in music; Siman was tall and strong, beyond comparison; and me? Haha, I was just an avid reader born in a family with a little extra Mora.

choices.text: Is this where you played house in childhood?

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: No, this is our secret world — I'm serious about it. We made a promise together, saying that we will never forget each other, and will lead the Reconquest Army to take back the castle...

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Hehe, 20 years have passed, and they might have forgotten our promise... It became my own research campsite in the forest, which was kept in operation till 30 years ago.

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: After that, even Marana had come, but the Reconquest Army never showed up. Hehe, that's understandable... How could those childish promises stand up against death itself?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But... Since you still remember them, they must be doing the same! Please don't lose your heart, Mr. Khayyam!

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Lose heart? No way. The childhood memories, shared "imaginary friends," and the world closed to adults. It may be a pity, but... Time won't reverse itself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Imaginary friends"... Do you mean Aranara?

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Haha... I almost forgot, I asked you to help me sample these newly-grown plants, not for chit-chat.

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Please forgive this old man for talking too much nonsense. Let's continue.

choices.text: Did you and your friends make all this...?

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: No, not all of these. We promised that we will lead the Reconquest Army to take back the castle... Hehe.

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: I grew up to be a botanical researcher in the Akademiya, and I happened to return here for some reconstruction. I visited multiple times, bringing and taking away plenty of rubbish here.

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Look, look here... The plants are thriving! It seems that the soil devastated by Marana could still nourish lively plants!

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Haha, Mawtiyima you old pal! Still active, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Mr. Khayyam seems to get younger all of a sudden!

choices.text: And Paimon seems to know what to say all of a sudden!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! What's that supposed to mean?

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Hmm... These should be enough. Thanks for coming all the way here with me. Since we have done everything planned, we should go now.

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Haha, this is excellent... These samples might really help my research on the secrets and weaknesses of The Withering...

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Thanks for your hard work, let us take the same route back... I have something for you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yay! Rewards!

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Hehe, it could be.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's not sure what you mean, but yay!

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Thank you both, Javans. It must've been hard, traveling with this old man.

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Right, if you don't mind... This is hardly anything precious, but take it as a souvenir.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... What is it? What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: You should have seen it before, this little dried flower.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ehhh!

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Yes. If I'm right... They must have gifted you the same thing, right?

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: Hehe... I knew it, our encounter is by no means coincidental... I never believe in chances.

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: I'm trusting this flower with you. Please, take it to our friends in common.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure, we can do that, but...

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: I can't see them, either... I can't even believe in their existence. Maybe... they are just my childhood fantasies...

response.speaker: Khayyam
response.text: But I am not giving up. Take this to them, children... Before the day you can never meet, before the possibility of a miracle fades.

dialogues.speaker: Khayyam
dialogues.text: Here, here it is! Let's collect the samples right here! Pick some, but be careful!
